item.title: Indian bishops’ conference chooses “outcast” cardinal as new head
item.description: On February 7, during its 37th general meeting, the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of India (CBCI) elected Hyderabad archbishop Cardinal Anthony Poola as its new conference president. Cardinal Poola succeeds Archbishop Andrews Thazhath of Trichur, a bishop of the Syro-Malabar Church.
